title: dead-code-report/v1
description: One report-only inventory of dead-code candidates at one commit. A finding is a candidate carrying the evidence that produced it and the nearest reason that evidence could be wrong. Nothing in this document establishes that a path or symbol is unused, and nothing in it authorises a deletion.

commit.description: The commit whose tracked tree was analysed.

universe.description: What was analysed, and what was excluded before analysis with the evidence that excluded it.

evidence.description: Why the classifier placed this path outside the analysed universe.

analysers.description: One entry per registered analyser. An analyser that did not run says so here, and an empty list means the report establishes no reachability result at all.

state.description: ran means the analyser completed over the universe. absent means its toolchain was not available. not-established means it ran and could not settle the signal. failed means it crashed, which stops the command.

symbol.description: The symbol or object the finding is about, or null when the finding is about the whole path.

evidence.description: What the analyser actually observed. Never a conclusion about usefulness.

confidence.description: How far the observation carries, given the reachability-defeating constructs the analyser saw nearby. Never certainty.

false_positive_boundary.description: The nearest reason this finding could be wrong.
